headline: Gulf venture capital funds expand financing to African startups
summary: Gulf venture capital firms are increasingly providing capital to African founders without requiring companies to physically relocate to Dubai.
why: Venture capital flows between the Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) and African tech ecosystems have accelerated in recent years.

impacts.name: United Arab Emirates
impacts.why: Cross-border VC allocations broaden funding options for African tech startups.
